apex-metrics.title: Apex Metrics — Phase One Engagement Scope
apex-metrics.summary: A diagnose-and-build phase that clarifies positioning, rewrites core pages, establishes SEO foundations, and delivers a marketing-owned site foundation before optional ongoing support.

phases.name: Diagnose & Message Architecture
deliverables: Site and messaging audit with prioritized fixes

phases.name: Core Narrative & SEO Foundation
deliverables: Homepage and primary offer page copy
Technical SEO and IA foundation for discovery

exclusions: Paid media buying or ad creative production
Custom application / product engineering outside the marketing site
Ongoing support retainer (optional add-on after launch)
assumptions: Economic buyer and marketing lead available for two workshops
Brand guidelines and current CMS access provided in week one
Budget comfort aligns to a phased diagnose-and-build engagement
apex-metrics.timeline_note: Target ~10–12 weeks calendar time with a spring launch window; schedule locks after scope approval.
